mainEntity.name: What kind of services does Native Horizons Treatment Centre offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Native Horizons Treatment Centre specializes in the treatment of mental health, substance, drug, and alcohol abuse. The center provides a range of services, including family services and outpatient drug rehab, as well as a variety of therapies such as holistic therapy, evidence-based practices, yoga, meditation, individual therapy, and counseling.

mainEntity.name: Where is Native Horizons Treatment Centre located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Native Horizons Treatment Centre is located in Hagersville, Ontario. The center is situated in the heart of the Mississaugas of the Credit First Nation, Ontario.

mainEntity.name: What is the center's approach to treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The team at Native Horizons Treatment Centre believes in addressing the whole person, rather than just their addiction or mental health condition. As such, the center offers a range of evidence-based practices, including holistic therapy, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, group therapy and counseling, nutritional counseling, art therapy, and nature therapy.

mainEntity.name: How experienced is the team at Native Horizons Treatment Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: Native Horizons Treatment Centre has over 30 years of experience in the field of addiction and mental health treatment. The center’s compassionate and expert staff offers residential, culturally-centered services in a nurturing, home-like atmosphere.

mainEntity.name: Does Native Horizons Treatment Centre offer virtual services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Native Horizons Treatment Centre offers virtual consultation services through its outpatient program. Patients can access these services remotely from the comfort of their own homes.

mainEntity.name: What kind of amenities does Native Horizons Treatment Centre offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Native Horizons Treatment Centre offers a range of amenities to support patients on their journey to recovery. These amenities include family services and outpatient drug rehab, as well as holistic therapy, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, group therapy and counseling, nutritional counseling, art therapy, and nature therapy.

mainEntity.name: Who can benefit from the services offered at Native Horizons Treatment Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: Native Horizons Treatment Centre is committed to healing individuals, families, and communities challenged by substance use and related mental health issues. Anyone struggling with addiction or mental health challenges can benefit from the center’s services, which are designed to support patients on their journey to lasting recovery.

about_blocks.text: Native Horizons Treatment Centre is an Indigenous addiction facility in Southern Ontario with over 30 years of experience in the field. The center is committed to helping individuals, families, and communities overcome substance use and related mental health issues through virtual, short- and long-term residential treatment programs, day treatment, and intensive outpatient substance abuse programs. The center is located in the heart of the Mississaugas of the Credit First Nation, and its compassionate and expert staff offers residential, culturally-centered services in a nurturing, home-like atmosphere. The center also offers outpatient services via virtual consultation by a team of trained professionals. If you or someone you know is struggling with addiction, reach out to Native Horizons Treatment Centre today for professional cultural healing.
